title: headwater-contributions/1
description: Printed by `headwater contributions --json`: for each product, what its score buys level by level, and the lines that move it most. Example, in the folder of `headwater demo`: `headwater contributions project/tshirt-footprint --json`.

path.description: The database or study folder, as given.

name.description: The name of the database or the study.

release.description: The release the background was read from, as name@hash. Null for a folder.

folder.description: The folder the background was read from. Null for a release.

background.description: The background the scores are calculated on.

method.description: The method the background was loaded with. Null when several methods are used together: `methods` names them.

methods.description: The id of each method the background was loaded with, in order.

unit.description: The unit of the score. Empty for a normalised score.

scenario.description: The scenario of the study the scores are calculated in, from `--scenario`. Null for none.

engine_version.description: The version of headwater that calculated the scores.

id.description: The id of the process that makes the product.

amount.description: How much of what the process makes is scored: 1 for a database, the study's amount for a study.

unit.description: The unit of the score. Empty for a normalised score.

tree.description: The contribution tree, the product at its root.

sensitivity.description: The lines that move the score most, largest elasticity first, as many as `--sensitivity` asks for. Null with `--sensitivity 0`, or when there is no sensitivity analysis: `no_sensitivity` says why.

no_sensitivity.description: Why there is no sensitivity analysis, such as a score of zero. Null otherwise.

input_hash.description: sha256 of the inputs the score is calculated from.

pin.description: The background the database or the study pins, as written: `toy-background@6864b7dbb65d`.

residual.description: The largest residual of the solves behind the score.

results.description: One entry per product: the one product of a database, or each product of a study, or the one `--product` names.

location.description: The code of the process's location, as its record holds it: `GLO`, `RER`.

flow_id.description: The flow the process makes, or the waste it treats.

amount.description: Units of the flow bought, or sent to treatment, in its reference unit.

per_unit.description: Score per unit of the flow: per kg made, or per kg treated.

share.description: The share of the whole score of the tree. Null for a score of exactly 0.

direct.description: Direct emissions of the process for this amount, characterised.

rest.description: Purchases left out by `--min-share` or `--depth`, summed. At the last level it is everything the process buys, which `score` already holds.

copy_of.description: For the database's own copy of a background process, made by an override, the id of that process. Null for every other process.

database.description: For a process of a database that the scored database uses, that database's name. Null for the scored database's own processes and the background's.

node.description: One process in the tree: score = direct + the children's scores + rest.

role.description: The role of the line, such as `input`, `waste_to_treatment`, `emission` or `resource`.

supplier_id.description: The process bought from, or sent to. Null for an emission or a resource.

supplier_name.description: Its name. Null for an emission or a resource.

amount.description: Per run of the process, in the flow's reference unit.

elasticity.description: % change of the score per 1% change of `amount`.

sensitivity.description: Change of the score per one more unit of `amount`.

copy_of.description: For the database's own copy of a background process, made by an override, the id of that process. Null for every other process.
